data.title: The Hillgate
data.about:
The Hillgate at Dubai Silicon Oasis by Ellington Properties is a collection of luxurious studio to 3-bedroom apartments and 3- and 4-bedroom duplexes moments away from Community Center Park. The project features two towers, Tower A and Tower B, which are seamlessly connected through a shared courtyard, providing a cohesive and inviting atmosphere. Tower A has16 floors above ground, complemented by two basement levels and a podium level. Meanwhile, Tower B offers a slightly shorter structure with 13 floors above ground, also including two basement levels and a podium floor. The central courtyard not only connects the two towers but also serves as a communal outdoor space. This architectural marvel stands tall in a nature-inspired setting, combining open spaces with stunning skyline views.

Strategically located, The Hillgate by Ellington Properties offers residents easy access to Dubai’s premier destinations and business centers. With a range of shopping, dining, and wellness options nearby, residents experience unparalleled convenience. The community's blend of residential and business infrastructure creates an ideal environment for families and professionals. Embrace the chance to live in a thriving mixed-use community where a seamless lifestyle awaits.

characteristics_module.title: Ellington Properties in Dubai Silicon Oasis: Crafted for Refined Living!
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Crafted by Ellington Properties: Developed by Ellington Properties, renowned for creating high-quality and luxurious residential communities that epitomize sophistication and comfort.
  • Stunning Dual Views: Enjoy both sunrise and sunset vistas from your home, offering breathtaking panoramic scenes.
  • Proximity to Nature: Located close to a community park, providing a serene environment for relaxation and outdoor activities.
  • Excellent Connectivity: Easy access to major highways, including Sheikh Zayed Bin Hamdan Al Nahyan Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, ensuring seamless commutes across Dubai.
  • Vibrant Community: Nestled in a lively neighborhood filled with lush parks, curated retail spaces, and essential amenities to enrich your daily life.
  • Attractive Pricing: Starting from AED 1,550 - 1,600 per square foot, with one-bedroom apartments priced at AED 1.2 million—ideal for families, professionals, and investors.

location_tile.title: Where Modern Luxury Meets Dubai’s Iconic Landmarks – The Hillgate Location
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Dubai Silicon Oasis is a vibrant, dynamic community that perfectly blends modern living with natural beauty. It is brimming with lush parks, curated retail spaces, and all the essential amenities that residents need for a comfortable lifestyle. Strategically positioned near two major highways, Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Sheikh Zayed Bin Hamdan Al Nahyan Road, the area offers seamless connectivity. Residents can reach Downtown Dubai in just 20 minutes, making it an ideal location for those who seek both a serene retreat and the convenience of being well-connected to the heart of the city. Whether it's for families or professionals, Dubai Silicon Oasis offers a balanced lifestyle with the best of both worlds.

  • 1 Minute - Community Central Park
  • 4 Minutes - Silicon Central Mall
  • 6 Minutes - Dubai Silicon Oasis Lake
  • 6 Minutes - Dubai Digital Park
  • 11 Minutes - Global Village
